verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a few narrow multi-item actions: the AI assistant can summarize multiple selected files, a trained classifier can auto-tag similar documents across a set, and snapshot recovery can restore files and folders with a single click. There is no documented general bulk operation (such as mass move, delete, permission change or metadata edit across many selected items) and no bulk API. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk actions on selected items, bulk permission or metadata editing, programmatic or agent-driven batch operations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: summarizing multiple selected files or knowledge bases
automatically recognize and tag similar documents
automatically restore files and folders with a single click
